title:
—Are you a strict t.t.? says Joe.
 
 —Not taking anything between drinks, says I.
html_source: Quick joke – Joe asking the narrator if he’s a teetotaler, and the narrator responding that he abstains from all alcohol, between refreshing alcoholic beverages.
